_readme: Follower template: the recommended multi-provider starting point.
Tier order: GLM coding plan (primary) -> MiniMax Token Plan (secondary) -> NVIDIA NIM free tier (overflow).
All secrets are environment-variable placeholders; export them before starting the router.
ZAI_API_KEY      - Z.AI GLM Coding Plan key (console > API keys; plan-bound)
MINIMAX_API_KEY  - MiniMax Token Plan key (platform.minimax.io, overseas region)
NVIDIA_API_KEY   - build.nvidia.com free trial key (optional overflow tier; trial/eval ToS, 40 RPM)
Sane defaults are preloaded: retry sweeps are ON with an 8-minute hold cap, kept below the 10-minute request timeout Claude Code and the Anthropic SDK use by default.
Set maxHoldMs to 0 (unlimited) only if your client timeout is larger than you
ever want to wait on a held request. Validate with: ccr-rust --config <this file> validate

Providers.name: zai
Providers._doc: Z.AI GLM Coding Plan via the Anthropic-compatible endpoint. honor_ratelimit_headers=false only affects header hints; real 429s are still tracked and the tier is skipped while limited.

Providers.name: minimax
Providers._doc: MiniMax Token Plan (overseas platform.minimax.io) via its Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Keep the sk-cp-... coding-plan key separate from pay-as-you-go keys.

Providers.name: nvidia
Providers._doc: NVIDIA NIM free trial tier, opt-in overflow: 40 RPM, no card, and build.nvidia.com terms cover prototyping/evaluation, not production — remove this tier before routing real workloads if that matters to you. A single sub-agent burst can exhaust 40 RPM. Verification status: config-load validated only (loader, provider contract, and tier checks, 2026-09-30); no live probe of the endpoint, model id, or rate-limit headers is recorded — see docs/zai_minimax_setup.md for the repo's bar for calling a route tested.

retrySweeps._doc: When every tier is exhausted, hold the request open and re-cascade the tier list after a cooldown instead of surfacing a 429 to the agent. maxSweeps bounds the re-cascades; unlimited sweeps during a sustained outage amplify load and spend, because one sweep issues up to (1 + tierRetries) upstream calls per tier and cooldown stretching only applies to tiers the rate-limit tracker is actively backing off. maxHoldMs caps the total hold time.

flash._doc: Bulk/cheap labor route; during Z.AI free-Flash promotion windows GLM-5.3-Flash consumes zero credits via supported clients.
